## Load and prepare data with python

```{python}
#| label: python-load-data
#| exec: false
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
trackpath = Path('/opt/project/_sources/launches/smore-002/tracking/spots')
trackfile = trackpath / 'KF8EEZ_109.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(trackfile)
df.sort_values('#',inplace=True)
df.set_index('#',inplace=True)
ojs_define(raw_spots=df)
```

## Make an ojs plot

```{ojs}
//| label: ojs-show-data-table
import { aq, op } from '@uwdata/arquero'
spots = aq.from(transpose(raw_spots))


viewof raw_table = Inputs.table(spots)

```

```{ojs}
//| label: adjust-to-date

spots_date = spots.derive({ spots{"date"} => op.parse_date(spots{"UTC Time"} })
//viewof raw_table = Inputs.table(spots_date)
```

```{ojs}
//| label: ojs-plot-altitude

Plot.plot({
  grid: true,
  x: {label: "Date/Time UTC"},
  y: {label: "Altitude meters"},
  marks: [
	//Plot.dot(spots, {x:"UTC Time" => d3.timeFormat("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M), y:"Altitude (km)"})
	Plot.dot(spots, {x:"UTC Time", y:"Altitude (km)"})
  ]
})
```
